title: Vegan Stuffed Sweet Potatoes with Black Beans and Salsa
summary: Baked sweet potatoes are filled with warm spiced black beans and finished with fresh salsa for a simple, hearty dinner. It’s savoury, lightly smoky, and bright with a fresh finish.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Scrub the sweet potatoes, prick them a few times with a fork, and rub them with a little olive oil and salt.
Place the sweet potatoes on a baking tray and bake for 35 to 45 minutes, until they are very tender when pierced with a knife.
While the sweet potatoes bake, heat the remaining olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the red onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, and chilli powder, then add the black beans, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until the beans are hot and lightly seasoned.
Warm the salsa in a small pan or microwave if you want a hotter filling, then stir in the lime juice and chopped coriander.
Split open each sweet potato and fluff the insides with a fork. Spoon the black bean mixture into the centres and top with salsa.
Serve immediately while hot, with any extra salsa on the side.
